Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring wood framing used in residential construction be tested for maximum allowable moisture content prior to enclosing the framing.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring wood framing used in residentialconstruction be tested for maximum allowable moisture content prior toenclosing the framing; and adding a new section to chapter 19.27 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.27 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The state building code council must adopt rules requiring thatnatural or manufactured wood framing members used in residentialconstruction be tested by a special inspector or the local buildingjurisdiction for maximum allowable moisture content prior to enclosingthe framing. The rules adopted under this section must provide for themaximum percentage of moisture allowed, the various locations in abuilding that must be tested, the standards that need to be appliedduring testing, and procedures for retesting the structure if themoisture content exceeds the maximum allowable amount at the time ofinspection. The rules may include a requirement that the specialinspector be tested and certified by the Washington association ofbuilding officials certification and registration program and beapproved by the local building official. p. 1 SB 6043 (2) After the inspection, the special inspector must provide acertificate of compliance to the local building official showingcompliance with the requirements of this section and the rules adoptedunder this section.
